question: When are applications due?
expected: Multiple receipt cycles on NIH standard dates: new applications February 5, June 5, and October 5, and renewal/resubmission/revision applications March 5, July 5, and November 5 (from February 05, 2025 through November 05, 2027), all due by 5:00 PM local time of the applicant organization; the NOFO expires January 08, 2028.
quote: All applications are due by 5:00 PM local time of applicant organization.

question: Is there a budget cap?
expected: No. Application budgets are not limited but need to reflect the actual needs of the proposed project; the maximum project period is 5 years.
quote: Application budgets are not limited but need to reflect the actual needs of the proposed budget.
